references.text: The continuation of the instructions regarding the loops, specifying that there should be fifty loops on each curtain edge.
Similar instructions about loops for the goat-hair curtains that were to cover the tabernacle.
The execution of these instructions, where Bezalel and the craftsmen made loops of blue violet on the curtain edges.
A parallel description of the fifty loops that were made on each curtain to fasten them together.
Mentions blue violet (תְּכֵלֶת) as one of the materials to be gathered for the sanctuary.
Direct continuation of the instruction to join the parts of the tent with 50 clasps to create unity.
Direct narrative follow-up: The hooks that are placed in the clasps to make the tent into one unit.
